events.text: Transfer status: sent. This status confirms the transfer was sent from your H&V account; it does not confirm that the recipient has returned the money.
I selected the wrong saved recipient for my pottery-studio bill transfer. My identity checks are complete, and I want H&V to register a request to seek the money's return.
I have verified the payer and checked the transfer details for case HV-005. Please register the prescribed request to seek a return; the customer has confirmed the recipient was selected in error.
I have registered the return request for case HV-005 against the verified transfer. Registration does not confirm that the money will be returned.

summary: Leona Mercer, a verified customer on a verified call, asked H&V to register a request to seek the return of a £286.40 transfer she sent to the wrong saved recipient. The record shows the payment team had already registered the return request as HV-005, so the desk did not submit a new one (that attempt and a query to the payment system were both refused) and sent her a reply instead, closing the case. Registration does not confirm that the money will be returned, and the record lists nothing further for a person to do.
